title: Waterjet: WAZER Pro and Desktop machines and gated dialect post (pending Q1 decision)

body:
Add WAZER Pro and WAZER Desktop machine files, cut-data presets from `wazer.com`, and a gated WAZER G-code post from public WAZER documentation.

**Gate:** Wait for maintainer sign-off on Open Question 1 in `#1525` (shipping WAZER inside built-ins with warnings vs shipping only as an external example post) before claiming this issue.

Depends on #1881, #1882, #1883, #1884, and #1885.

## Scope

- **Machine files (`assets/machines/`):**
  - Add WAZER Desktop and WAZER Pro `.mch` definitions (`kind: "waterjet"`, `mm` units, `X 0..460` mm, `Y -305..0` mm fixed top-left origin, no Z axis, `1500 mm/min` max feed, `NoSpindle`).
  - Ship nozzle/cut-data preset templates (`1.1 mm` kerf, 80-mesh garnet) from published Pro vs Desktop cut rates, pierce times, and max stock limits (`wazer.com/land/materials-specs/`).
- **WAZER dialect `.cps` post (`assets/posts/`):**
  - Implement only WAZER public *Understanding G-code* and *Visualization of the G-code cut file* specifications (`support.wazer.com`). Do not read WAM JavaScript or third-party Fusion posts.
  - Emit CRLF lines, `;` metadata header comments (material name truncated to 20 chars, thickness, cut time), `M1403` init, `M1405`/`M1406` bounding box, `M1407` re-pierce dwell, `M1410`–`M1413` tags, `G90`/`G21`, linearized `G0`/`G1` moves, `M3`/`M5` water valve, `M8`/`M9` abrasive valve, `G4 S<sec>` dwells, and `M1404` shutdown.
- **Warranty and resume warnings:**
  - Put clear warranty and terms-of-service warnings in `.cps` comments, G-code header comments, and `PostOutput.warnings` stating the output is unofficial and not WAZER-approved.
  - Warn users that third-party pause/resume behavior lacks public verification, and ask the maintainer for a dry-run hardware check before live cutting.
- **Decision record:**
  - Record the Q1 warranty decision and the `.wzr` out-of-scope decision in `docs/decisions/`.

**Done means:** WAZER Desktop and Pro `.mch` files enforce `X 0..460` / `Y -305..0` mm and `1500 mm/min`, the WAZER post matches a golden CRLF `.nc` test with clear warranty and unverified-resume warnings, and `docs/decisions/` records Q1 and `.wzr` scope.

Part of #1525
